svg.title: Detector
svg.desc: The detector reads h, 32 numbers from the flow encoder, and s, 100 numbers from the detection encoder. One head per day maps the 132 numbers through a hidden layer of 64 to one output per class. Thresholds are quantiles of benign scores on calibration rows at the chosen false-alarm budget; test labels are never used. An event alerts for a family when that family's probability reaches its threshold; a host alerts after three such events in a row, and alerts with no quiet gap longer than 60 seconds form one incident.
